_comment: Import duty on gold bars (HS 7108). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for India gold import duty (D2, 2026-09-24) -- the live pipeline (ml.feature_store, ml.calendar_events, ml.inr_proxy) reads this file; data/duty_events.json is retired. total_duty_pct = BCD + AIDC + SWS (SWS = 10% of BCD where it applied); IGST 3% is excluded because IBJA rates are quoted ex-GST. Duty is levied on CBIC's tariff value, not on the market price. `rows` below are all CBIC-notification-cited (2019-07-06 onward) and are the only rows premium/research code (scripts/analysis_derived_premium.py) may read. The separate `unverified_pre_2019` key holds three press-sourced-only 2013 hikes (notification numbers could not be verified) -- read ONLY by ml.inr_proxy's pretraining proxy, which needs duty coverage back to 2013; see that key's own _comment.

rows.effective_date_basis: no commencement clause; in force on publication, 06.07.2019
rows.status: BCD verified from notification text; SWS component inferred (gold not exempted from SWS until No. 34/2022-Customs)

rows.notification: No. 2/2021-Customs (S.No. 356: 12.5% -> 7.5%) and No. 11/2021-Customs (AIDC Sl.No. 16, gold: 2.5%), both dated 01.02.2021
rows.effective_date_basis: 'shall come into force on the 2nd February 2021' (both)
rows.status: BCD and AIDC verified from notification text; SWS component inferred (consistent with WGC's 14.07% total incl. GST = 1.1075 x 1.03)

rows.notification: No. 33/2022-Customs (S.No. 356: 7.5% -> 12.5%) and No. 34/2022-Customs (SWS on 7108 exempted), both dated 30.06.2022
rows.effective_date_basis: no commencement clause; e-Gazette signed 01.07.2022 01:08 IST, so first in force for IBJA's 01.07.2022 fixes

rows.notification: No. 02/2023-Customs (S.No. 356: 12.5% -> 10%) and No. 03/2023-Customs (AIDC Sl.No. 15D, gold: 5%), both dated 01.02.2023
rows.effective_date_basis: 'shall come into force/effect on the 2nd day of February, 2023'
rows.status: verified from notification text (03/2023 re-read 2026-09-24); total unchanged, composition changed

rows.notification: No. 30/2024-Customs (S.No. 356: 10% -> 5%) and No. 32/2024-Customs (AIDC Sl.No. 15D: 5% -> 1%), both dated 23.07.2024

rows.notification: No. 15/2026-Customs (amends No. 45/2025-Customs, S.No. 196: 5% -> 10%) and No. 16/2026-Customs (AIDC Sl.No. 15D: 1% -> 5%), both dated 12.05.2026
rows.effective_date_basis: 'shall come into force on the 13th day of May, 2026'
rows.status: notification text read on a third-party mirror, not yet on cbic.gov.in or egazette.gov.in

unverified_pre_2019._comment: D2 migration (2026-09-24): the three 2013 current-account-deficit-crisis BCD hikes, carried over from the retired data/duty_events.json (2013-01-01/2013-06-01/2013-08-01 entries) with NO new sourcing -- press retrospectives (Business Standard / ThePrint) give month-level precision only, no CBIC notification number was ever found for any of the three, and AIDC/SWS did not exist yet (AIDC introduced 2021, SWS on gold not confirmed applicable before 2018) so total_duty_pct here is BCD-only, not the BCD+AIDC+SWS basis the verified `rows` use from 2019-07-06 onward. Consumed ONLY by ml.inr_proxy (the long-history pretraining proxy, which needs duty coverage back to 2013-01-01) via duty_schedule.load_all_rows_including_unverified(); every other consumer (ml.calendar_events, ml.feature_store, ml.feature_store_backfill, scripts/analysis_derived_premium.py) reads `rows` only and never sees this key. The rate in force immediately before 2013-01-01 (4%) is not a row here -- it has no notification either, it is a fixed starting assumption documented as ml.inr_proxy._BASE_DUTY_PCT.
